question: Where are a garden within 180 kilometers from Fresenius Medical Care at Preakness Healthcare Center, Wayne, NJ on the southwest side?
sql: SELECT P.park_name FROM parks AS P WHERE P.leisure = 'garden' AND ST_DWithin(P.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Fresenius Medical Care at Preakness Healthcare Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Wayne%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 180000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Fresenius Medical Care at Preakness Healthcare Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Wayne%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%' LIMIT 1), P.geometry )) BETWEEN 202.5 AND 247.5;
